body:
Maintainer-directed policy change, split out of #474 per its round-four review (out-of-scope rider). CHANGELOG.md becomes release-time-authored: the release flow drafts each version's section from merged PRs since the previous tag; PRs stop maintaining an `Unreleased` section (their descriptions are the per-change record). Docs-and-prompt only — no behavior change; the existing `Unreleased` content is absorbed into the next release, as the docs now state.
